gloss: vinyl sheet; plastic tarp; ground sheet

definitions.gloss: vinyl sheet; plastic tarp; ground sheet
definitions.explanation: A large flat piece of vinyl or plastic material used as a ground cover, protective sheet, or tarp. Commonly used for picnics, outdoor events, construction sites, and disaster preparedness.

examples.japanese: ビニールシート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}いて→敷く：00366_shiku⟧⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: We spread out a vinyl sheet and sat down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧ビニールシート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧いった。
examples.english: I brought a large plastic sheet for the cherry blossom viewing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ビニールシート⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{覆|おお}った→覆う：02020_oou⟧。
examples.english: In preparation for the typhoon, we covered the roof with a vinyl tarp.

notes:
A wasei-eigo (Japanese-English compound) from ⟦ビニール→ビニール：11140_biniiru⟧ (vinyl) + ⟦シート→シート：10945_shiito⟧ (sheet). In English, the closest equivalents are "tarp," "ground sheet," or "plastic sheet" depending on the context. The blue vinyl tarps (⟦ブルー→ブルー：11276_buruu⟧⟦シート→シート：10945_shiito⟧) seen at construction sites and disaster areas are the most iconic type.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ビニールシート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧: to spread out a vinyl sheet
- ビニールシート⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{覆|おお}う→覆う：02020_oou⟧: to cover with a vinyl sheet
- ビニールシート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to stretch/put up a tarp
- ⟦{防水|ぼうすい}→防水：06428_bousui⟧ビニールシート: waterproof vinyl sheet

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, ビニールシート is closely associated with ⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧ (cherry blossom viewing) and other outdoor gatherings. People spread blue sheets under trees to claim spots in parks. At construction sites and after natural disasters, blue tarps (⟦ブルー→ブルー：11276_buruu⟧⟦シート→シート：10945_shiito⟧) are ubiquitous.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ブルー→ブルー：11276_buruu⟧⟦シート→シート：10945_shiito⟧: blue tarp — the standard blue construction/emergency tarp
- {敷|し}き{物|もの}: ground covering — more general term for anything laid on the ground
- ⟦レジャー→レジャー：11200_rejaa⟧⟦シート→シート：10945_shiito⟧: leisure sheet — specifically for recreational outings
